title: SpaceX files plan for $55 billion Terafab chip facility in Texas
title_zh: SpaceX 提交了在德克萨斯州投资 550 亿美元建造 Terafab 芯片工厂的计划
summary: Elon Musk's SpaceX, in a joint project with Tesla, has proposed investing $55 billion ‌to build a semiconductor manufacturing facility, called Terafab, ‌in Texas, according to a filing made public on Wednesday.
summary_zh: 根据周三公布的一份文件，埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 旗下的 SpaceX 在与特斯拉的一个联合项目中，提议投资 550 亿美元在德克萨斯州建造一家名为 Terafab 的半导体制造工厂。

title: Schneider Electric to launch Southeast Asia training hub in Malaysia
title_zh: 施耐德电气将在马来西亚设立东南亚培训中心
summary: French energy technology firm Schneider Electric plans to open a Southeast Asian training centre in ‌Malaysia this year, a senior executive said on Wednesday, as ‌a boom in artificial intelligence infrastructure drives up power demand in the region.
summary_zh: 法国能源技术公司施耐德电气计划今年在马来西亚开设东南亚培训中心，一位高管周三表示，因为人工智能基础设施的蓬勃发展推动了该地区的电力需求。

title: AMD forecast sparks AI‑driven rally in US chipmaker stocks
title_zh: AMD 预测引发人工智能驱动的美国芯片制造商股票上涨
summary: U.S. semiconductor stocks rose on Wednesday as Advanced Micro Devices' strong outlook boosted investor confidence about sustained demand for AI infrastructure and that a ‌shift toward CPUs would spur the next leg of spending.
summary_zh: 美国半导体股票周三上涨，因 Advanced Micro Devices 的强劲前景提振了投资者对人工智能基础设施持续需求的信心，并且向 CPU 的转变将刺激下一阶段的支出。

title: Samsung Electronics' market cap surpasses $1 trln after US AI chip stocks surge
title_zh: 美国人工智能芯片股飙升后三星电子市值突破1万亿美元
summary: The market capitalisation of Samsung Electronics' ‌common stock surpassed $1 trillion ‌on Wednesday, making it the second ​Asian company after TSMC to reach the milestone.
summary_zh: 周三，三星电子普通股市值突破 1 万亿美元，成为继台积电之后第二家达到这一里程碑的亚洲公司。

title: Exclusive-Rivian mulls making its own lidar sensors, possibly in partnership with Chinese firms
title_zh: 独家-Rivian 考虑生产自己的激光雷达传感器，可能与中国公司合作
summary: Rivian Automotive is considering making its own lidar sensors and could do so in partnership with a Chinese firm, CEO ‌RJ Scaringe said in an interview with Reuters on Tuesday.
summary_zh: Rivian Automotive 首席执行官 RJ Scaringe 周二在接受路透社采访时表示，Rivian Automotive 正在考虑制造自己的激光雷达传感器，并可能与一家中国公司合作。
